meta.description: Member-facing instructions for how a patient finds/downloads their own plan and coverage documents online, per carrier. Shown to the patient so they can locate (or upload) their policy. Written in plain language for a non-technical user. Always also offer 'the number on the back of your ID card' as the fallback.

find_plan_docs_steps: Log in to your insurance company's member website or app (the web address is usually on the back of your insurance card).
Look for a section called 'Plan Documents', 'Coverage & Benefits', or 'My Plan'.
Open your 'Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC)' or plan booklet and download the PDF.
If you can't find it, call the Member Services number on the back of your card and ask them to send your plan documents.
generic_fallback.member_phone: See the number on the back of your insurance card.

find_plan_docs_steps: Go to member.uhc.com (or myuhc.com) and click 'Sign In' (first time: click 'Register' and use the member ID on your card).
In the top menu click 'Coverage & Benefits'.
Choose 'Coverage Documents' (also shown as 'Plan Documents').
Open your 'Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC)' or 'Member Handbook' and download the PDF.
UnitedHealthcare.notes: Public medical coverage policies are at uhcprovider.com/en/policies-protocols.html (no login).

find_plan_docs_steps: Go to aetna.com, click 'Log in', choose 'Members' (first time: 'Register' with the member ID on your card).
Open 'Coverage & Benefits' (may say 'Plan Documents').
Open your benefits summary / SBC and download it.
No login needed for just the SBC: use aetna.com/sbcsearch/home.
Aetna (CVS Health).notes: Public medical policies ('Clinical Policy Bulletins') at aetna.com/health-care-professionals/clinical-policy-bulletins.html.

find_plan_docs_steps: Go to my.cigna.com or open the 'myCigna' app and log in (first time: 'Register' with the ID on your card).
Open the 'Coverage' or 'Plan Documents' section.
Open your 'Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC)' and download the PDF.
Go to anthem.com and click 'Log In' (or open the 'Sydney Health' app). First time: 'Register' with the info on your card.
Open the 'Benefits' section.
Find 'Plan Documents' or 'Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC)' and download it.
Elevance / Anthem BCBS.member_phone: Use the number on the back of your ID card (varies by state/plan; TTY 711)
Elevance / Anthem BCBS.notes: Public medical policies at anthem.com/provider/policies/clinical-guidelines (pick your state).

find_plan_docs_steps: Go to account.humana.com or open the MyHumana app and sign in (first time: 'Activate account' as a Member with your Humana ID, date of birth, and ZIP).
Open 'Coverage & Benefits' or 'Plan Documents'.
Or, faster: go to plandocs.humana.com/medicare-plan-documents and enter your ID, date of birth, and ZIP to download your plan documents.
Humana.member_phone: 800-457-4708 (Medicare, TTY 711), or the number on your card

find_plan_docs_steps: Ambetter (marketplace): go to ambetterhealth.com, pick your state, click 'Member Login' (goes to member.ambetterhealth.com) and sign in.
Open the 'Coverage' section and scroll to 'Plan Documents'.
Download your 'Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC)' or 'Evidence of Coverage (EOC)'.
WellCare (Medicare): sign in at member.wellcare.com, or use wellcare.com/en/find-your-plan to open your plan's documents.
Centene (Ambetter/WellCare).member_phone: Use the number on the back of your ID card (varies by state/plan)
Centene (Ambetter/WellCare).notes: Ambetter is Centene's marketplace brand run per state; WellCare is the Medicare brand. Clinical policies posted per state under Provider Resources; some delegated to Evolent/RadMD/TurningPoint.

HCSC (BCBS IL/TX/NM/OK/MT).app_name: Blue Access for Members (BAM) — your state's BCBS app
find_plan_docs_steps: Go to your state's Blue site (IL bcbsil.com, TX bcbstx.com, NM bcbsnm.com, OK bcbsok.com, MT bcbsmt.com) and click 'Log In' (first time: 'Register Now' with the ID on your card).
Open 'My Coverage' or 'Benefits'.
Choose 'Plan Documents' or 'Benefit Booklet' and download your SBC / benefit booklet.
HCSC (BCBS IL/TX/NM/OK/MT).member_phone: Use the Member Services number on the back of your ID card (varies by state/plan)
HCSC (BCBS IL/TX/NM/OK/MT).notes: Member portal is 'Blue Access for Members (BAM)' on all 5 state sites; only the web address changes. Public medical policies via medicalpolicy.bcbsil.com.

find_plan_docs_steps: Go to mymolina.com and sign in (first time: 'Create an Account' with your Member ID, date of birth, and ZIP).
For full plan documents, also go to molinahealthcare.com, choose 'Members', pick your state, and open 'Member Materials and Forms'.
Open your Member Handbook / Evidence of Coverage / SBC and download it.
Can't find it? Call Member Services and they'll mail a free paper copy.
Molina Healthcare.member_phone: Use the Member Services number on the back of your ID card (varies by state/program)
Molina Healthcare.notes: Heavily Medicaid/Marketplace; documents organized by state and program. Public policies: molinahealthcare.com/providers/common/Policies/MolinaClinicalPolicies.aspx.

find_plan_docs_steps: Go to floridablue.com and click 'Log In' (first time: 'Register' with the member ID on your card).
Open 'My Plan' / 'Plan Documents' / 'Member Resources'.
No login needed for the SBC: use floridablue.com/sbc/search/byplan. For the full benefit booklet: floridablue.com/plancontracts/individual.
Florida Blue / GuideWell.member_phone: 1-800-352-2583 (TTY 1-800-955-8770), or the number on your card
Florida Blue / GuideWell.notes: Public medical coverage guidelines at mcgs.bcbsfl.com.

Medicare.app_name: Medicare.gov (web; no official Original Medicare app)
find_plan_docs_steps: Go to medicare.gov and click 'Log in / Create account' (create one with the Medicare Number on your red-white-and-blue card).
View your Part A & B coverage, claims, and card.
To check if a service is covered, use medicare.gov/coverage ('Is my test, item, or service covered?').
Your Medicare Summary Notice (MSN) is mailed every 3 months and viewable in your account.
Medicare.notes: Detailed provider rules (NCDs/LCDs) at the Medicare Coverage Database on cms.gov. Medicare Advantage/Part D documents come from the private plan, not Medicare.gov.
